pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1, 8.8.1.3.1 and 8.8.1.3.1.1 (standard intermediate data item, 'a precision of 32 decimal digits', rounding to 31; the PB5575 gap is the compiler's 34). They govern the evaluation of an arithmetic expression only. Matched by 'constant entry'; GR1 permits a reference to the variable (in directives, a defined condition, a constant entry with FROM) and does not say how an expression is evaluated. No dependence.

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined, src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Expressions/CompileTimeArithmetic.cs#For) picks only the mode in which a compile-time arithmetic expression is evaluated: Standard at 2002, as §2002:7.2.5.2 GR1 requires ('Standard arithmetic shall be used for all arithmetic operations'). GR1 says where a compilation variable may be used; it evaluates nothing. g1_uses.cob re-run now at --std 2002 prints USES-OK, EVAL-V (rerun.log).
